# Make `mission --help` exit successfully

## Problem

The public mission CLI prints usage for `--help` but returns exit code 1 and
prints `Error: Arguments("Usage: ...")`. The behavior was reproduced through
Cargo against the current workflow-tools checkout.

## Reproduction

```text
cargo run -p mission --features cli --bin mission -- --help
```

Observed: usage is printed, followed by the `Arguments("Usage: ...")` error;
the process exits with status 1.

The mission CLI propagates the shared transport-harness argument-parsing
error. The shared parser maps Clap help-display errors to
`HarnessError::Arguments`; the ticket CLI handles help as successful output.
See [mission.rs](../../workflow-tools/mission/crates/mission/src/bin/mission.rs),
[transport-harness lib.rs](../../workflow-tools/memory-kernel/crates/transport-harness/src/lib.rs),
and [ticket CLI](../../workflow-tools/ticket/src/bin/ticket-cli.rs).

## Expected behavior

The `mission --help` command should print usage and exit successfully. Invalid
arguments must continue to produce a nonzero exit status.

## Acceptance criteria

- `mission --help` prints usage and returns exit code 0.
- Invalid command-line arguments still return a nonzero exit code.

## Scope

This ticket covers the mission CLI help exit status only. It does not implement
the fix, change the dossier migration contract, or duplicate the separate
migration/workflow issue tracked by
[ticket c5d40e2a](../../.workflow-tools/ticket/tickets/c5d40e2a-aaa8-4996-b7df-d281e6c75989/ticket.toml).

# Review findings

No issues found in the focused review of the Mission CLI help handling and public-binary integration regression.

- Top-level and `validate-preview` help display usage and exit successfully.
- Invalid arguments still return a nonzero exit status.
- The regression invokes the public Cargo binary and covers all three behaviors.
- Focused tests, formatting, and whitespace checks pass; validation records are linked to this ticket and read back.
